accepted.reason: OpenAI combines unusual internal pretraining-loss disclosures with an explicit cross-lab pacing proposal and candid limitations. The story remains Important because the measurements are private and unreproduced, the forecast is extrapolated, and the proposal is not an adopted standard.

Project MONAI's signed 0.8.6 release closes the previously documented no-patched-release gap, adds a second traversal fix, and supplies concrete upgrade and incident-review guidance without proving deployment or remediation coverage.
